description: Copy source to destination — Copies objects from a source remote to a destination remote without deleting destination files.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_config.description: JSON encoded config overrides applied for this call only.

_filter.description: JSON encoded filter overrides applied for this call only.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

createEmptySrcDirs.description: Set to true to replicate empty source directories on the destination.

dstFs.description: Destination remote path to copy to.

srcFs.description: Source remote path to copy from.

name: sync_copy
